about_the_game:
I know what you're thinking-"Maybe if I was a beetle, my life wouldn't suck". Newsflash pal, you're right. How could a beetle playing soccer with dung balls be sad? Anyway, that's why we've invested our life savings into bringing you BeetleBall, the greatest multiplayer dung beetle soccer game on Steam.

Fun Movement Mechanics

You have full control over where and how you move in the dung field. Climb up a wall, glide down at full speed, and steal an enemy's ball to roll it straight into their net!

Unique Classes

Find a play style that suits you with a diverse roster of beetle classes based on real species. Each beetle has unique abilities that can shift the balance of each round.

More than one Ball

Compete for freshly dropped dung balls and merge them together to form a golden ball, or steal the enemy's ball right out of their hands.

Game Changing Map Design

BeetleBall is not limited by the verticality of standard soccer (football) fields. Each map offers a unique experience that keeps each game feeling fresh and exciting.

short_description: Revel in the primal joy of sport, excrement, and arthropods in BeetleBall, THE GREATEST MULTIPLAYER DUNG BEETLE SOCCER GAME TO EVER EXIST. Team up with friends, pick a class, and climb the ranks in this chaotic beetle battle!
